answer: Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the anchor queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1521 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the vine. The ivory index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 124 account operation therefore ties up 31 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
